McpOutputUpcomingIpoRow.description:
The IPO page (`mixins/ipo_page.py`, page21) — two independent scrapes of stockanalysis.com: completed IPOs for one year, and every upcoming US IPO through 31 December.

Every cell except the date is the scraped text itself. The reference passes those strings straight into its table and never parses a dollar figure, so neither does this: a missing value is the literal `'--'`, not a `null` this app would then have to format. `shared/ipo.ts` owns the windows, the dedupe and the sort keys those strings need.
